71509318.description: Foscenvivint is a CREB-binding protein/β-catenin inhibitor that is developed for the treatment of liver diseases such as primary biliary cholangitis, hepatocellular carcinoma, and hepatitis C and B...

71811910.name: Omaveloxolone
71811910.description: Omaveloxolone, sold under the brand name Skyclarys, is a medication used for the treatment of Friedreich's ataxia.

73415750.name: Technetium (99mTc) pentetic acid
73415750.description: Technetium pentetic acid, sold under the brand name Draximage DTPA among others, is a radiopharmaceutical medication used in nuclear medicine to image the brain, kidneys, or lungs.

76071622.name: F-17475
76071622.description: F-17475 is an NMDA receptor antagonist described as an analgesic, which was under development for the treatment of postoperative pain but was never marketed.

90716102.name: TDBzcholine
90716102.description: TDBzcholine is a diazirine analog of acetylcholine that can be used to label the nicotinic acetylcholine receptor.

129867334.name: Sodium hexachloroosmate
129867334.description: Sodium hexachloroosmate is the inorganic compound with the formula Na2OsCl6.

135409350.name: Trimethoprim/sulfadoxine
135409350.description: Trimethoprim/sulfadoxine, sold under the brand name Trimidox, is an antibacterial agent that is used in cattle and swine to prevent and treat infections by both gram-negative and gram-positive...

137528262.name: Berotralstat
137528262.description: Berotralstat, sold under the brand name Orladeyo, is a medication used to prevent attacks of hereditary angioedema.

146478790.name: 5-HO-MET
146478790.description: 5-HO-MET, also known as 5-hydroxy-N-methyl-N-ethyltryptamine, is a psychedelic drug of the tryptamine and 5-hydroxytryptamine families related to bufotenin .

172871878.name: 2F-MAR
172871878.description: 2'-Fluoro-4-methylaminorex is a recreational designer drug from the substituted aminorex family, with stimulant effects, first reported in 2018.

177841734.name: Einsteinium(II) bromide
177841734.description: Einsteinium bromide is a binary inorganic chemical compound of einsteinium and bromine with the chemical formula EsBr2.

900000198.name: Aselizumab
900000198.description: Aselizumab is an immunosuppressive drug which has been investigated for the use in severely injured patients. It binds to CD62L.

900000326.name: Bufagin
900000326.description: Bufagin is a toxic steroid C24H34O5 obtained from toad's milk, the poisonous secretion of a skin gland on the back of the neck of a large toad (Rhinella marina, synonym Bufo marinus, the cane toad).

900000454.name: Chitosan
900000454.description: Chitosan is a linear polysaccharide composed of randomly distributed β- -linked D-glucosamine and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine .

900000582.name: Depemokimab
900000582.description: Depemokimab, sold under the brand name Exdensur, is a humanized monoclonal antibody used for the treatment of asthma.

900000710.name: Eltrekibart
900000710.description: Eltrekibart is a "septa-specific monoclonal antibody that neutralizes all seven ELR+ CXC chemokines , thereby limiting signaling through CXCR1 and CXCR2".

900000838.name: Flotetuzumab
900000838.description: Flotetuzumab is a bispecific antibody designed for the treatment of acute myeloid leukemia. This drug is being developed by MacroGenics, Inc.

900000966.name: IGF-1 LR3
900000966.description: Long arginine 3-IGF-1, abbreviated as IGF-1 LR3 or LR3-IGF-1, is a synthetic protein and lengthened analogue of human insulin-like growth factor 1 .

900001222.name: Macupatide
900001222.description: Macupatide is a glucose-dependent insulinotropic polypeptide receptor agonist under development for diabetes and obesity.

900001350.name: Neptunium trioxide
900001350.description: Neptunium trioxide is an inorganic compound of neptunium and oxygen with the chemical formula NpO3.

900001606.name: Poly(hexamethylene carbonate)
900001606.description: Poly is an organic polymer. It can be biodegredated to form adipic acid and di carbonate by Roseateles depolymerans 61A.

900001734.name: Pyroligneous acid
900001734.description: Pyroligneous acid, also called wood vinegar or wood acid, is a dark liquid produced by the destructive distillation of wood and other plant materials.

900001862.name: Sepsivac
900001862.description: Sepsivac is a drug developed by Cadila Pharmaceuticals to treat gram-negative sepsis.

900001990.name: Telluride (chemistry)
900001990.description: The telluride ion is the anion Te2− and its derivatives.
